cases.name: sort-feature-prop-asc
cases.comment: Concrete feature-property sort (the sort lateral binds path = wpath = the concrete wpath to use the full search_flat key prefix). zsort-a/-d hold arrays (ASC sorts by the MIN element), zsort-b also has feature meter2 with reading 1, so the /features/*/properties/reading twin rows carry a smaller value than its own meter reading (5) and must not leak into the sort, zsort-c misses the key (null rank, first) although its meter2 twin rows carry 99, zsort-e is a string (after all numbers). Sort keys carry no auth on either backend (plan §3.3 exception 3), so every auth situation must agree, incl. 'limited' (features revoked). The zsort-* ids sort after every other parity id so first-page-pinned divergence lists (not-wildcard-eq) stay stable, and every zsort feature carries status "on" (so only the full eq-wildcard-status-on pin lists them) because a feature WITHOUT status would trip a separate, pre-existing empty(features/*/...) divergence in empty-wildcard-property: Mongo matches a thing with a feature that lacks the property, Postgres does not.

cases.name: sort-feature-prop-desc
cases.comment: DESC twin of sort-feature-prop-asc: arrays sort by their MAX element, the missing key sorts last. zsort-c's meter2 reading 99 is larger than every meter reading, so a leak of the /features/* twin rows would move zsort-c from last to first.

cases.name: walk-rank-asc
cases.comment: Walks the dedicated single-type-bracket walker corpus: missing-value things exercise the null-sort-value resume branch (D4 review gap), int/long/double values cross the numeric sub-type boundaries and the 42/42 tie exercises the eq-dimension resume. Mixed-type brackets are NOT cursor-crossable on EITHER backend (shared upstream type-bracketed gt/lt limitation, see PostgresCursorResumeIT), and explicit-null sort values duplicate on both backends after a null boundary (exists(key) matches explicit null), so those stay in the SORT battery (sort-rank-asc/desc) but out of the walks.

cases.name: walk-feature-level-asc
cases.comment: Cursor walk on a concrete feature-property sort key: the three f1 things without a level exercise the null-anchor resume branch, the 3/3 tie the eq-dimension resume. Scalars only (no arrays, no explicit nulls), per the walk-corpus rules in SearchBackendParityIT.

cases.name: walk-rankdiv-asc-divergent-encodings
cases.comment: Pins each backend's OBSERVED walk over container-valued sort keys: the divergent cursor sort-value encodings (Mongo: whole array; Postgres: null for rank-4/5 boundaries) plus type-bracketed resume predicates make each backend drop a DIFFERENT subset mid-walk. The unpaged-reference invariant is deliberately not applied to pinned walks (see SearchBackendParityIT.runCursorWalkComparison).

cases.name: in-thingid-value-null
cases.comment: null-operand Mongo-parity battery (SB-01), root-mapped thingId (Mongo _id, Postgres column; never null, never missing): in(thingId,v,null) matches exactly the listed id -- the null member can match nothing.

cases.name: ge-thingid-null
cases.comment: null-operand Mongo-parity battery (SB-01), root-mapped thingId: ge(thingId,null) = {_id:null} matches NOTHING because _id is never null nor missing (the thing-level counterparts ge-attr-nullattr-null etc. DO match missing leaves).

cases.name: gt-thingid-null
cases.comment: null-operand Mongo-parity battery (SB-01), root-mapped thingId: gt(thingId,null) matches NOTHING on both backends.

cases.name: not-gt-namespace-null
cases.comment: null-operand Mongo-parity battery (SB-01), root-mapped namespace: not(gt(namespace,null)) matches every visible thing (negation of a never-matching predicate).

cases.name: in-namespace-value-null
cases.comment: null-operand Mongo-parity battery (SB-01), root-mapped namespace: in(namespace,v,null) matches exactly the things of the listed namespace -- the null member can match nothing (namespace is never null nor missing).

cases.name: and-in-nullattr-value-null-eq-color-red
cases.comment: null-operand Mongo-parity battery (SB-01), selective-leg shape: and(in(p,v,null), eq(color,red)) -- scalars-red and parityb-red (nullAttr MISSING, color red) match; the in() with a null member is not a point leg, eq(color) is.

cases.name: and-in-nullattr-value-null-exists-size
cases.comment: null-operand Mongo-parity battery (SB-01), selective-leg shape: and(in(p,v,null), exists(size)) -- no point leg at all (in() carries null, exists never is one); every thing with a size attribute and a missing/null/listed nullAttr matches.

cases.name: and-eq-color-red-in-nullattr-null
cases.comment: null-operand Mongo-parity battery (SB-01), selective-leg shape: and(eq(color,red), in(p,null)) -- eq(color) is the point leg; in(p,null) (null OR missing) must not be hoisted; scalars-red and parityb-red match.

cases.name: count-in-attr-nullattr-value-null
cases.comment: null-operand Mongo-parity battery (SB-01), count mode: in(p,v,null) counts the listed value, the JSON-null leaf and every MISSING leaf (everything but nenull-stringvals).

cases.name: not-ge-attr-nullattr-null
cases.comment: null-operand Mongo-parity battery (SB-01), attribute path: not(ge(p,null)) is the complement of null-or-missing -- only a leaf that EXISTS with a non-null value matches (nenull-realvals, nenull-stringvals), like ne(p,null).
